answer: In an agent economy, every identity must earn its place in a shared haven by staking reputation built from peer-verified work, not by minting new keys. A raven-like sentinel network samples random agents each epoch and audits their history; any identity whose record is hollow — no real tasks, no attestations, no stake at risk — is quarantined before it can vote or earn. Cloning therefore buys nothing: each fake must fund genuine work and locked capital to pass the audit.
